{{Quote|It's a beautiful language to listen to. I only regret that I'll never speak it as well as a Chiss.|[[Jorj Car'das]]|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
'''Cheunh''' was the official [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]]. It was adopted across [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]] early in Chiss history. Cheunh was a complex, dense tongue that used comparatively few core words and an involved syntax to express ideas; more complicated ideas were expressed by combining related words into a larger whole.

The written form of Cheunh was represented ideographically, and the agglutinative features of the spoken language were reflected in the written form, which combined simpler ideograms to present more complex ideas. The Chiss found the complex nature of their tongue to be a source of pride.

As Humans did not share the same vocal abilities as the Chiss, it was difficult for other species to pronounce it correctly, even after long periods of study. It followed a logical pattern, though, and could be understood after some study.

The Chiss also used [[Minnisiat/Legends|Minnisiat]] and [[Sy Bisti/Legends|Sy Bisti]] as ''lingua franca'' to trade in the space around their frontiers.

==Known words/word roots==
*''Ch'tra'' - Go<ref name="Outbound" />
*''Crahsystor'' - [[Commander/Legends|Commander]]<ref name="Outbound" />
*''Ktah'' - A curse word<ref name="Force Heretic II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>
*''Pohskapforian'' (aspirated ''p'' in second syllable) - Merchant trader<ref name="Outbound" />
*''Pohskapforian'' (unaspirated ''p'' in second syllable) - Fishing boat<ref name="Outbound" />
*''Sch'oktai'' - Doctor
*''Stae'' - Near (pronounced: "stee")<ref name="Outbound" />
*''Vasbo'' - [[Color/Legends|Green]]
*''[[Visvia]]'' - A unit of measurement (Visvia:kilometer ratio around 5:8)<ref name="Outbound" />

==Known phrases==
*''Crahsystor Mitth'raw'nuruodo. Ris ficar tli claristae su fariml'sroca.''<ref name="Outbound" />
*''Sa eras mi sout shisfla. Hos mich falliare.''<ref name="Outbound" />
*''Pavl'cha sertketch Jedi lommeeth'ree, Nuru Kungurama agad nac'shu Republic depostchw'ukak tah Palpatine. Pavl'cha ferch'sti'onmell Aristocra Sev'eere'nuruodo.''<ref name="Curse of the Black Hole Pirates">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''</ref>
*''Ka sba'ma'ti orf k'ralan. Kra'miral sumt tara'kliso mor Mitth'raw'nuruodo sur pra'cin'zisk mor'kor'lae.''<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>
*''Moactan teel'' - fair-haired<ref name="Force Heretic I">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>
